points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Eight original case directories structurally validate, but Re200 target statistics are not strict and Re20 plateau misses lift drift; rank-local restart lacks transient history.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: Original structural validator passes eight case packages; curated report lacks mandatory manifest/assets and cannot compile. Structural passage is not physics or convergence validation.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Re200 last strict inner ratio 0.3696 vs 0.001 and counted fraction uses relaxed acceptance; Re20 claims stable plateau at 0.564 orders despite late lift drift.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re200 t≥150 mean Cd 1.905 and broad St≈0.28, Re20 Cd 2.959; lift drift, poor residual reductions and unverified strict transient convergence materially limit credibility.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Report.tex references figures but neither rendered figures nor sibling PDF survive; archived report cannot compile. Raw data and scripts are not delivered figures.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report discloses relaxed Re200 acceptance and full traction but inaccurately says no full mesh per rank and asserts stable Re20 forces; referenced figures are unavailable.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Report gives numeric case summary and workspace raw outputs, but mandatory manifest and figures are absent from curated report; independent figures cannot be reconstructed as contestant deliverables.
